reviews.text: They take exceptional care of my cat and always offer great advice. You never feel pressured into buying anything, and they give you all the time you need to decide what is best.

Really bad experience, they don’t have respect for the clients, I had to go 2 days in a role, they didnt gave the meds for my dog on the first day, so I had to come back and they overcharged me for that, not coming back there again.

I have had a terrible experience with this clinic across three consecutive visits with my cats, and unfortunately I cannot recommend their service.

On my first visit, I brought four kittens for their first vaccinations. When I arrived, I was told that the clinic did not have the vaccines in stock and asked whether I wanted to reschedule. I had received no prior notification about this issue. Since I had already spent money and time travelling to the clinic and the kittens needed to be vaccinated that day, I declined to reschedule. I then had to wait approximately 1.5 hours while staff went to another clinic to obtain the vaccines.

A couple of weeks later, I brought two adult cats for their booster vaccinations. Again, I was told there would be a wait. I ended up waiting for approximately one hour for an appointment I had booked in advance.

Today was the third and most frustrating experience. I had appointments for three kittens to be microchipped and receive their second vaccinations. Just three hours before the appointment, I received an email informing me that the clinic’s vaccine fridge had broken and the vaccines could not be used. My appointment was therefore moved to another clinic.

This caused additional inconvenience and travel costs, and, to make matters worse, the alternative clinic charged me more than the original clinic would have charged.

Three consecutive visits, three separate issues, and each time I was the one left dealing with the consequences of the clinic’s poor organisation and communication.

On top of this, I find their prices extremely expensive. I have since found a clinic in Mayfair that charges less, despite this clinic already being significantly more expensive than I expected.

Overall, this has been an extremely disappointing experience. I would not recommend this clinic to other pet owners. I expect better communication, organisation and customer service from a veterinary clinic, especially when it comes to essential vaccinations and the care of animals.
Thank you Kevin, class vet
